# SocialTap for Go

SocialTap is the social media scraper API for developers and AI agents. Send a public link, a handle or a search and get live data back in one schema. Failed requests are free.

The Go SDK for the SocialTap API: a method for every endpoint, typed models and errors, retries and pagination.
Generated from the SocialTap catalog (version 1.582.32). Docs: https://socialtap.dev/docs. Source: https://github.com/SocialTapDev/socialtap-go.

## Install

Not published to the Go module proxy yet: install it from source, a checkout of the SocialTap repository (this directory is
`sdk/go`).

```sh
go mod edit -require=socialtap.dev/sdk/go@v0.0.0 -replace=socialtap.dev/sdk/go=./sdk/go   # the path to the checkout
```

Zero dependencies (net/http); Go 1.23+. The module path is `socialtap.dev/sdk/go` (a vanity path on our domain,
so it survives a move of the hosting repository); the package name is `socialtap`. Optional params are pointers
(`socialtap.String("en")`); nullable model fields are pointers (nil = unknown); slices are never null in responses.
Every method takes per-request `Option`s (`socialtap.WithTimeout`, `WithMaxRetries`, …), the same ones `NewClient` takes.
Errors match `errors.Is(err, socialtap.ErrNotFound)`-style sentinels; `errors.As` gives the `*APIError`.

Nothing is invented: with `Fields` set, `Data` is left zero (`Partial` is true) and `Raw` holds the selected members
(`Pager.AllRaw`; `All` returns `ErrPartialItems`). Every response keeps `Raw` (the data as received) and `Body`, so members
this version doesn't model are not lost. A 2xx that is not the API's envelope is a `*DecodeError`; a `retry-after` longer than
`MaxRetryAfter` is a `*RetryAfterError` (it unwraps to the `*APIError`) instead of an early retry. `Event.TypedData()`
decodes an event's data by its type; each endpoint's Params has a method building a job item typed by that endpoint.

## Authenticate

The client reads your API key from `SOCIALTAP_API_KEY`, or takes it as an option. Requests send it in the
`x-api-key` header. Get a key at https://socialtap.dev/signup/: every account starts with 100 free credits.

## First call: Exact follower and like counts, bio and country

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"

	socialtap "socialtap.dev/sdk/go"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	client, err := socialtap.NewClient() // the API key defaults to $SOCIALTAP_API_KEY
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	res, err := client.TikTok.Profile.Get(ctx, socialtap.TikTokProfileParams{Handle: "nasa"})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(res.Data)
	fmt.Println(res.Credits.Charged, res.Meta.RequestID)
}
```

(charged by this request, and the balance after it when the API reports it). Failed requests and cache hits are free.

### Endpoints newer than this package

A version has a method for every endpoint the API had when it was released. For a newer one, update the
package, or send the request yourself: the raw request adds your key and retries and raises errors like a method,
and returns the status, headers and body (the envelope, `data` and `meta`). Each endpoint's docs page has its path
and params.

```go
res, err := client.Do(ctx, socialtap.RawRequest{Method: "GET", Path: "/v1/tiktok/profile", Query: url.Values{"handle": {"nasa"}}})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(res.Body))
```

## Errors

Every API error is an `*APIError` with `StatusCode`, `Code`, `Retryable`, `Remediation`, `RequestID` and
`CreditsCharged` (0: errors are free), and matches its code's sentinel with `errors.Is`. Codes this SDK version
doesn't know keep their `Code` and match no sentinel; no response at all is a `*ConnectionError`.

```go
res, err := client.TikTok.Profile.Get(ctx, socialtap.TikTokProfileParams{Handle: "nasa"})
var apiErr *socialtap.APIError
switch {
case errors.Is(err, socialtap.ErrNotFound):
	// Check the link or ID. Do not retry.
case errors.As(err, &apiErr):
	log.Println(apiErr.Code, apiErr.StatusCode, apiErr.Retryable, apiErr.Remediation, apiErr.RequestID)
case err != nil:
	log.Fatal(err) // a *socialtap.ConnectionError after retries, or ctx
}
```

| code | class | status | retried |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invalid_input` | `ErrInvalidInput` | 400 | no |
| `invalid_cursor` | `ErrInvalidCursor` | 400 | no |
| `unauthorized` | `ErrUnauthorized` | 401 | no |
| `forbidden` | `ErrForbidden` | 403 | no |
| `insufficient_credits` | `ErrInsufficientCredits` | 402 | no |
| `spend_limit_reached` | `ErrSpendLimitReached` | 402 | no |
| `rate_limited` | `ErrRateLimited` | 429 | yes |
| `request_too_large` | `ErrRequestTooLarge` | 413 | no |
| `method_not_allowed` | `ErrMethodNotAllowed` | 405 | no |
| `endpoint_retired` | `ErrEndpointRetired` | 410 | no |
| `idempotency_key_reused` | `ErrIdempotencyKeyReused` | 422 | no |
| `idempotency_key_in_progress` | `ErrIdempotencyKeyInProgress` | 409 | yes |
| `job_not_found` | `ErrJobNotFound` | 404 | no |
| `unknown_endpoint` | `ErrUnknownEndpoint` | 404 | no |
| `not_found` | `ErrNotFound` | 404 | no |
| `private_or_unavailable` | `ErrPrivateOrUnavailable` | 403 | no |
| `no_transcript` | `ErrNoTranscript` | 404 | no |
| `no_live` | `ErrNoLive` | 404 | no |
| `no_media` | `ErrNoMedia` | 404 | no |
| `no_readme` | `ErrNoReadme` | 404 | no |
| `unavailable_for_legal_reasons` | `ErrUnavailableForLegalReasons` | 451 | no |
| `upstream_blocked` | `ErrUpstreamBlocked` | 503 | yes |
| `upstream_error` | `ErrUpstream` | 502 | yes |
| `overloaded` | `ErrOverloaded` | 503 | yes |
| `internal` | `ErrInternal` | 500 | yes |

## Retries and timeouts

Retryable failures (the codes above, connection errors, timeouts) are retried 2 times by default with
exponential backoff and jitter, honoring `retry-after`. A GET retry sends `max_age` set to the seconds since the first
attempt: if the first response was lost in transit, the retry is served free from the cache. Timeouts are per
attempt: 60 s by default, and 300 s for endpoints that may transcribe audio (`facebook.ad_transcript`, `facebook.transcript`, `instagram.transcript`, `kick.transcript`, `linkedin.transcript`, `reddit.transcript`, `rumble.transcript`, `tiktok.transcript`, `twitch.transcript`, `x.transcript`, `youtube.transcript`), because speech-to-text on long
media takes minutes, and for create-and-wait's long-polls. Most requests answer in a few seconds. A timeout you set, on the client or on one request,
applies to every endpoint, and so does `maxRetries`.

## Pagination

List endpoints return one page (`data`, `page.has_more`, `page.next_cursor`). `Iterate` returns a `Pager` (range over `All()` for items, `Pages()` for pages) with
two guards, `IterateOptions{MaxPages, MaxCredits}`; afterwards `PagesFetched`, `CreditsCharged`, `StopReason` (`StopEnd`, or the guard that
stopped it) and `EndReason` (the API's `page.end_reason`) say what happened. A nil guard is no limit; `socialtap.Int(0)` stops at once.
Each page is checked against its catalog price before it is fetched, and an empty page with `has_more` is not the end.

```go
pager := client.Amazon.DealProducts.Iterate(ctx, socialtap.AmazonDealProductsParams{}, socialtap.IterateOptions{MaxPages: socialtap.Int(10), MaxCredits: socialtap.Int(100)})
for item, err := range pager.All() {
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(item)
}
fmt.Println(pager.PagesFetched(), pager.CreditsCharged(), pager.StopReason(), pager.EndReason())
```

## Account, API keys, jobs, webhooks and events

The gateway's own routes (account, usage, credit ledger, API keys, jobs, webhook endpoints, events) are free and
have methods too, named from their operation IDs (`<noun>.<verb>`, or `<noun>.<sub>.<verb>` for a sub-resource). They
answer the same envelope (`data`, `meta`, `credits`) with their own `meta`; cursor-paged list routes have `iterate` like
list endpoints. Every POST sends an `idempotency-key` header (yours, or a new UUID kept for the call's retries), so it is
retried like a GET and a retry never repeats the work; `replayed` says when the API answered from an earlier request
with the same key, and `status` is 202 when accepted work continues. Each route needs a key with the scope below (a key
never gets a scope its creator lacks).

```go
res, err := client.Account.Get(ctx)
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
fmt.Println(res.Data, res.Meta.RequestID)
```

|---|---|---|
| `account.get` | `client.Account.Get(ctx)` | `account:read` |

### Jobs and webhooks

Many requests (or one long list walk) run as a background job at the synchronous prices; failed items are
free. The create-and-wait helper creates one, long-polls it until it ends and returns every result; one Idempotency-Key
covers the create's retries, so a retry never runs a job twice. Webhook deliveries are signed per Standard Webhooks:
verify the raw body with your endpoint's secret before trusting it, and deduplicate on the event ID.

```go
out, err := client.Jobs.CreateAndWait(ctx, socialtap.JobsCreateParams{Requests: []socialtap.JobRequest{{CustomID: "row-1", Endpoint: "tiktok.profile", Params: map[string]any{"handle": "nasa"}}}})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
for _, r := range out.Results {
	fmt.Println(r.CustomID, r.Status)
}

// A webhook delivery: the raw body, the request headers, your endpoint's secret.
event, err := socialtap.VerifyWebhook(body, req.Header, os.Getenv("SOCIALTAP_WEBHOOK_SECRET"))
```

## Tools for AI agents

The SDK hands the SocialTap MCP server's tools to a model: each tool's name, description (its price
and rules included) and input JSON Schema, and a call that sends one stateless MCP request with your key. A tool
behaves exactly as it does for an MCP client: concise results (`detail: "full"` for every field), `next_cursor` to
continue, and failures returned as the tool's output (`error` with `retryable` and `remediation`) so the model can
act on them. Transport failures raise as for any request, and tools that may be repeated are retried.

```go
// Hand each tool (Name, Description, InputSchema) to the model, run its calls with CallTool.
for _, t := range socialtap.Tools {
	fmt.Println(t.Name, t.Description, string(t.InputSchema))
}
r, err := client.CallTool(ctx, "find_endpoint", map[string]any{"query": "Exact follower and like counts, bio and country"})
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
fmt.Println(r.IsError, string(r.Output))
```

## Versioning

The version is derived from the API contract: major = API version, minor = the contract's revision (it grows
with every additive change, a new endpoint included), patch = the SDK generator's revision. Questions and bug reports: support@socialtap.dev.
